title: INFACT: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Induced Faithfulness and Factuality Hallucinations in Video-LLMs

layout.note: Two dashed rounded containers stacked top and bottom, a green one for faithfulness and an orange one for factuality; each holds three aligned rows of tinted label band, four-frame strip and question card, so six categories share one grammar.

lesson: Show a two-level benchmark taxonomy as stacked rows, one per category, each pairing a tinted label band, a four-frame strip and the question with its correct option highlighted; group the rows in dashed containers per family and give each family its own hue.
